description: Hand-built TracksTimeline inputs for evaluate_loitering()'s per-zone dwell-threshold boundary, exercised directly (no build_tracks_timeline()/reid/calibration involved). fps=1.0 so frame_idx doubles as elapsed seconds; gap_tolerance is set generously (1000) so each case's two observations always form a single continuous run -- the only thing under test is the started_at/ended_at dwell-time comparison against the zone's loiter_seconds.

below_threshold.description: Track 3 observed at frame 0 then frame 29 -- dwell = 29s, just BELOW the zone's 30s loiter_seconds -> zero events.

above_threshold.description: Track 4 observed at frame 0 then frame 30 -- dwell = 30s, AT/above the zone's 30s loiter_seconds -> one event.
